rows.headline: Calculating the corpus needed for retirement income
rows.hook: Inflation erodes retirement purchasing power
rows.summary: A monthly expense of Rs 40,000 today is projected to rise to Rs 1.72 lakh in 25 years due to inflation. This calculation assumes a 6% annual inflation rate over the two-and-a-half-decade period. Retail investors must account for rising living costs when planning their long-term retirement savings goals. Failing to adjust for inflation can lead to a significant shortfall in post-retirement financial security.
rows.why_it_matters: Retirement savings targets must be adjusted for future inflation.

rows.headline: Comparing the real value of cash today versus future retirement goals
rows.hook: Inflation erodes the value of future savings
rows.summary: Inflation significantly impacts the purchasing power of money over long time horizons. A lump sum of Rs 50 lakh today may provide more utility than Rs 1 crore a decade later depending on the prevailing inflation rate. Retail investors must account for rising costs when planning long-term financial goals. Failing to adjust for inflation can lead to a shortfall in retirement corpus.
rows.why_it_matters: Inflation-adjusted planning is essential to meet future lifestyle costs.
